about_the_game:
⚠️ Original Steam buyers of Desktop Mark when it was paid will receive this DLC for free. If you have the game via Steam Key, you will have to buy it.



Desktop Mark - Magic is a silly little extra to the free game Desktop mark, unlocking the following features:
  • Magic effects on hats & skins
  • On-demand minigames
  • 20% off every merchant item
  • Special menu & card theme
  • Be listed as a supplier for everyone
  • Re-roll the minigames wheel

Purchasing this DLC helps the game's development a lot, but is certainly not required to experience the base game.
